title: Connected Identity Intelligence Platform for Digital Investigation
funder: Government of Sindh — Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)
description: Addresses three under-studied identity resolution problems in Pakistan: multilingual entity resolution with Urdu/English NER and CNIC-aware matching, LLM-driven generation of Urdu and English name variants with confidence scores, and demographic-fairness audited face matching on a regionally representative test set. Deliverables include trained models, annotated benchmark datasets, model cards, and an open API specification.

title: Integrated Information Discovery System for Digital Investigation
funder: Government of Sindh — Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)
description: An on-premises investigation workspace for regulatory, compliance, audit, and journalistic work. Cuts hours of manual gathering and cross-checking public data from disconnected sites down to minutes while keeping every result traceable to its source with human oversight.

title: An Agentic AI-Powered Tour Guide for Safer and Smarter Travel in Pakistan
funder: NED Alumni Association of Southern California (NEDAASC)
description: An agentic AI holiday planning platform developed at NED University that automates family travel across Pakistan by synthesizing flights, hotels, live weather forecasts, road hazards, and regional budget optimization.

title: National Center of Big Data & Cloud Computing (NCBC) Testbed
description: GPU cluster infrastructure compute grant supporting federated multi-modal clinical diagnostic models and high-performance neural workloads across NED departments.

title: Low-Resource Regional Language Knowledge Distillation
description: Cross-lingual parameter-efficient fine-tuning exploring transfer from high-resource Indo-Aryan languages to regional scripts and vernacular low-resource Urdu NLP tasks.

title: Sub-4-Bit Quantized Edge Robotics Acceleration
funder: PyTorch Foundation / Meta AI Hardware Grant
description: Edge deployment kernels testing INT4/FP4 quantization for embedded aerial UAV spatial visual odometry on embedded Jetson Orin boards.
